title: Purple Spirit Warrior
description: Three full-body poses of a female warrior with short white hair, wearing a revealing purple and silver fantasy outfit with leaf-like armor details. She is surrounded by swirling purple smoke and energy effects, shown in dynamic action stances against a solid dark background.
prompt: A powerful dark-skinned female warrior with short spiky white hair, wearing ornate purple and silver fantasy armor with leaf motifs, bare midriff, and matching leg wraps. She is shown in three different dynamic action poses on a black background, surrounded by swirling translucent purple smoke and energy effects emanating from her body and feet, digital character concept art style.
